assets.install: by kaal-guard init, and by upgrade where the repository does not have it
only by kaal-guard init --ci, the consumer opting in; never by upgrade

rules.install: only where no file exists, byte for byte as catalogued content, registered in the installation record; the workflow only on the consumer's request (init --ci), and never beside a workflow that already declares a check or verify
rules.upgrade: only a registered asset whose SHA-256 equals the registered one; a modified asset keeps its registered version
rules.remove: only a registered asset whose SHA-256 equals the registered one, with the directories its removal empties

record.checkout: kaal/guard/state.json in Git's metadata: the common directory, or the worktree's own with extensions.worktreeConfig
